items.html: Afterwards, on the sixth day, she returned to grow in the third aspect mentioned above — her being a complete Partzuf in the aspect of back to back, opposite the chest of ZA; and then there are in her the five lights of the first five Sefirot of ZA, which are the aspect of the first five days of the days of Genesis — all of them illuminated on the sixth day, which is his Tifferet; and then Malchut is built and revealed there, and the five lights illuminate in her from afar.
